## Problem

What problem does this change solve, and why is this the smallest complete solution?

## Evidence

Link the issue, primary sources, measurement artifact, or design decision behind the change.

## Verification

List the commands or manual checks performed.

## Impact

- [ ] Changes data or freshness
- [ ] Changes provenance or ranking
- [ ] Changes third-party reuse conditions
- [ ] Changes executable behavior and includes tests
- [ ] Contains no credentials, personal data, or material I cannot contribute
- [ ] Commits are signed off under the DCO
